spots.title: Guide mode
spots.body: This walks you around the player one part at a time, including the shortcuts that make it faster to use. Use the arrow keys or the buttons below to move, and Esc to stop. To explore on your own, switch to Point and ask and hover over anything.

spots.title: Tabs
spots.body: Library holds your songs, Playlists your playlists, and Lyrics the words to whatever's playing. A Now Playing tab with a big cover shows up once a song starts.
tips: Right-click the Lyrics tab to list every song that has lyrics.

spots.title: Search
spots.body: Filters your library as you type and matches artists too. Enter plays the first match. If nothing matches, Enter searches YouTube instead, with Preview and Add on every result.
tips: Paste a YouTube link here and press Enter to add that exact video.
Songs in other alphabets match Latin spellings: saranghae finds 사랑해, eto finds Это.
Hover the funnel for filters: favourites, has lyrics, downloaded, and language.

spots.title: "topic" toggle
spots.body: Adds the word topic to YouTube searches. Topic uploads are the official audio-only versions, which load faster and use less data. Struck through means off.

spots.title: Filters
spots.body: Hover to open. Each row is Yes, Any or No: favourited, has lyrics, downloaded. Language guesses each song's language from the letters in its title.

spots.title: Global library
spots.body: Somewhere to find new music: the Billboard Hot 100 top three, a few random picks, a search for artists, songs and premade playlists, and Mix Lab, which builds a mix of new songs from a few of yours. Click any song to hear a preview before adding it.
tips: Click the "Billboard Hot 100" heading inside for the full chart.

spots.title: Mix Lab
spots.body: Pick up to five songs from your library, or type a mood, genre or artist like "rainy day" or "songs like Daft Punk", then Create mix. Play runs the whole mix in the player, all songs that aren't in your library yet; click a song to play from there.
tips: Shuffle plays the mix in random order, and New picks makes a fresh one.
Import as playlist adds every song to your library and saves the mix as a playlist.
Hover a song for + to add it to your library or x to hide it.

spots.title: Modify Library
spots.body: Add a song from a YouTube link. Paste the link and the name fills itself in, and Autofill tidies it into a song name and artist. The Import/Export tab backs up your whole library as plain text.
tips: Hover Autofill to preview what it'll write before you click.

spots.title: Your library
spots.body: With the search empty this is your home screen: favourites, playlists, and a shuffled grid of your songs. In a list, every song has favourite, play, edit and delete buttons.
tips: Right-click a cover or a play button to add the song to the queue instead of playing it.
Drag an audio file from your computer onto a song to play it from that file.

spots.title: Favourites
spots.body: Every song you've starred. Scroll it sideways with the mouse wheel. Play plays them all in order, All shows them as a list.
tips: Right-click a cover to queue it.

spots.title: Playlists shelf
spots.body: Your playlists as cover tiles. Click one to play it, hover it to edit or delete it, or click the New playlist tile to make one.

spots.title: From your library
spots.body: A shuffled grid of your own songs, for when you don't know what to play. Shuffle deals a new set, Show all lists everything.
tips: Right-click a cover to queue it.

spots.title: A song
spots.body: Click the name to play it. The star favourites it, the pencil edits it (name, artist, a better video, a local file, lyrics), and the bin deletes it. Small icons after the name mean it has lyrics, a local file, or a star.
tips: Right-click the play button to add it to the queue.
Drop an audio file on it to play it from your disk.

spots.title: Music Explorer
spots.body: What's playing, what you played recently, and songs to play next. Click to play.
tips: Right-click any song here to queue it.
Click the "Recently Listened To" heading for your full history.
Click "Suggested" or "Your Picks" to reshuffle them.
Section sizes and order live in Settings, Recommendation.

spots.title: Section heading
spots.body: Recently Listened To opens your full history. Suggested and Your Picks reshuffle when clicked.

spots.title: Music Explorer song
spots.body: Click to play it.
tips: Right-click to add it to the queue.

spots.title: Control bar
spots.body: The song that's playing, its progress, and what plays after it. Click anywhere on the progress bar to jump there.
tips: Right-click the song name to copy it.

spots.title: Song name
spots.body: What's playing right now.
tips: Right-click to copy it.

spots.title: Next
spots.body: What plays after this one. It counts the queue and any songs you've skipped.

spots.title: Playback buttons
spots.body: Previous, play, next, loop this song, autoplay (keep going when a song ends), the playlist side panel, and speed from 0.25x to 2x.
tips: Hover next or previous to see the three songs on that side.

spots.title: Previous
spots.body: Goes back a song.
tips: Hover to see the three songs before this one.

spots.title: Next
spots.body: Skips to the next song. The queue goes first, then the playlist.
tips: Hover to see the next three songs.

spots.title: Play / pause
spots.body: Plays or pauses.

spots.title: Loop
spots.body: Repeats the current song until you turn it off.

spots.title: Autoplay
spots.body: When on, the next song starts by itself when one ends. When off, playback stops after each song.

spots.title: Playlist side panel
spots.body: Opens the songs of the playlist that's playing. Only works while a playlist is playing.

spots.title: Speed
spots.body: Playback speed, from 0.25x to 2x. It's remembered for next time.

spots.title: Volume
spots.body: Drag to set the volume.

spots.title: Progress
spots.body: Click anywhere on the bar to jump there.

spots.title: The queue
spots.body: Songs that play next, before the playlist carries on. Open it with Y. Search to add songs, use − and + to play one several times, and drag to reorder. The header can shuffle, add a stop block (playback stops there), add a loop block (the song before it repeats forever), or clear everything.
tips: Right-click a song's play button anywhere to queue it. Right-click it again to make it play twice.
Right-click a playlist's cover to queue the whole playlist.

spots.title: Queued song
spots.body: Drag the grip to move it. − and + set how many times it plays. The other buttons duplicate or remove it.

spots.title: Playlists
spots.body: Every playlist as a cover tile, with Favorites first. Click one to play it. Hover it for the pencil (open the editor) and the bin (delete, after you confirm). New playlist starts an empty one. The editor has a Name box for renaming, your songs on the left to drag, shuffle, reverse or remove, and your library on the right to add from. Changes save as you go.
tips: Drag a tile to reorder your playlists. The library shelf follows the same order.
Right-click a cover to add the whole playlist to the queue.
The search box also finds playlists by the songs and artists in them. Enter plays the top match.

spots.title: Playlist
spots.body: Click to play it. An empty playlist opens in the editor instead so you can add songs. Hover for edit and delete.
tips: Drag a tile to reorder.
Right-click the cover to queue every song in it.

spots.title: Search playlists
spots.body: Finds playlists by name, then playlists that contain a matching song or artist, then artists you can turn into a playlist. Press Enter to play the top match.

spots.title: New playlist
spots.body: Name it and the editor opens, ready for you to add songs from your library.

spots.title: Playlist from an artist
spots.body: Pick an artist and every song of theirs in your library becomes one playlist named after them. Featured artists count too, so a song by A ft. B lands in both. Open it again after adding more of their songs and the row offers to add just the new ones.

spots.title: Playlist side panel
spots.body: The songs of the playlist that's playing. Click one to jump to it. You can search it, loop it, or widen it into an expanded panel with covers. If no playlist is playing yet, this button opens it once one is.
tips: Long-press a song here to skip it for now. It stays in the playlist, and another long-press brings it back.

spots.title: Song in this playlist
spots.body: Click to play it.
tips: Long-press to skip it for this session. Long-press again to bring it back.

spots.title: Lyrics
spots.body: Lines light up as they're sung. The round buttons keep the current line centred, copy a karaoke link with the lyrics inside it, and open fullscreen lyrics in five styles. No lyrics yet? Transcribe lyrics lets you time them by tapping along, and Import subtitles pulls them from the video's captions.
tips: Right-click the Lyrics tab to see every song that has lyrics.

spots.title: Lyrics tab
spots.body: The words to the song that's playing.
tips: Right-click for a list of every song that has lyrics.

spots.title: Now Playing
spots.body: A big cover with its own controls. Clicking the Now Playing card in Music Explorer also brings you here.

spots.title: Tools
spots.body: Left to right: switch theme, disguise the tab, listening statistics, sleep timer, Discord, identify a song that's playing around you, downloads, and settings.

spots.title: Theme
spots.body: Cycles light, dark and your custom theme. Settings, Theme has glass mode, backgrounds and your own colours.

spots.title: Disguise
spots.body: Makes the tab look like Docs, Gmail, Classroom and so on, or covers the player with a real website while the music keeps going. Esc brings the player back.

spots.title: Listening statistics
spots.body: Your top songs and artist, plays and time listened, for 30 days or all time. Click a song for its play history. Turn it on first in Settings, Additional.

spots.title: Sleep timer
spots.body: Stops the music or closes the app after a set time, or at a set clock time. While it runs, the time left shows next to the clock icon.

spots.title: Discord
spots.body: Shows what you're listening to on your Discord profile. Needs a small helper program on your computer, linked inside.

spots.title: Identify a song
spots.body: Listens to a tab, your system audio, the microphone or a clip, and tells you what song it is.

spots.title: Downloads
spots.body: Download the current song, any song from your library, or any YouTube link as MP3. Search library lists every song A to Z: scroll through them or search in any language the library search understands. Songs you have already downloaded carry a green Downloaded mark. Drop the file back onto the song to play it from disk.

spots.title: Settings
spots.body: Themes and glass, Music Explorer sections, keyboard shortcuts, feedback, the visualizer, library sorting and statistics.

spots.title: Listening time
spots.body: How long you've listened in total, and how many visits the site has had.

spots.title: Layout buttons
spots.body: This one hides the control bar for a cleaner screen. The one above it moves the playback buttons left, centre or right.

spots.title: Button alignment
spots.body: Moves the playback buttons to the left, centre or right of the bar.

spots.title: Version
spots.body: Click to read the changelog.

spots.title: A few more keys
spots.body: Every shortcut can be changed in Settings, Keybinds. A few that are worth learning first:

spots.title: That's the tour
spots.body: Point and ask is still here if you want to check something else, and Alt + Shift + G brings guide mode back any time. The tutorial has screenshots of everything.
